div.span:
Project to 128, ReLU
h: one vector per tile

Sample ≤512 tiles, standardise
(all tiles when predicting)

Gated attention (64)
tanh ⊙ sigmoid → score per tile

Softmax → tile weights
top tiles = evidence shown

Slide embedding (128)
weighted sum of h

Classifier ÷ temperature
6 classes, untrained ones masked

Calibrated probabilities → call
gate, novelty check, per patient

How it trains: Adam, class-weighted cross-entropy,
one bag per step · 5 patient folds in parallel ·
temperature fitted out of fold · gate: exact bound,
≤5% error at 95% · final model on all patients

H&E whole-slide image
0.25–0.5 µm per pixel

1,536 numbers per tile
tiles read in parallel, batched

Bag per slide (.npz)
median about 9,000 tiles
